topic: Hiding a known basement leak when selling a house vs disclosing it upfront (Conrad vs Calla)

scenes.narration: Hiding a leak when you sell can cost more than fixing it. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench beside a small house with water dripping in the basement, comic burst banner reads DISCLOSE IT, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Conrad and Calla both sell homes with a basement that leaks in heavy rain.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man conrad and woman calla each standing in a basement with a puddle and a water stain, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both know about it. Both have mopped it up more than once.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a mop and bucket beside a stained basement wall, a calendar with rainy days marked, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Conrad paints over the stain and checks no on the disclosure form.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man conrad painting over a water stain, a form with NO checked beside BASEMENT WATER, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The house sells fast. The first spring storm floods the basement.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a sold sign in front of the house while rain pours and water fills the basement window, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The buyer finds the fresh paint and the old repair receipts.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a buyer peeling back paint to reveal a stain, a receipt reads WATERPROOFING ESTIMATE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Conrad is sued for fraud and settles for thirty eight thousand dollars.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, man conrad at a courtroom table signing a settlement reading THIRTY EIGHT THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Calla writes the leak on her disclosure and gets a repair quote.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman calla filling a form with YES checked beside BASEMENT WATER, a quote reads NINE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She prices the house four thousand lower and offers a credit.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a listing sheet reading PRICE REDUCED FOUR THOUSAND, REPAIR CREDIT OFFERED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: The buyer accepts with eyes open, and the deal closes clean.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman calla and a buyer shaking hands at a closing table, a stamp reads CLOSED, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Conrad lost thirty eight thousand and his reputation. Calla lost four thousand.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel, man conrad beside a giant settlement bill, woman calla beside a small credit tag reading FOUR THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Disclose every known defect. It is cheaper than a lawsuit. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel beside a disclosure form with every box honestly checked, kids comic book illustration
